player_prompt.intro:
Kɩlaŋ sɩ Pɛlɛɛ {player_id} ({role}) kɛ kɛlɛmɩŋ {num_rounds} tʊmɩyɛ Matching Pennies tʊmɩyɛ taa.
- Kɩlaŋ tʊmɩyɛ taa, kɛʊ [heads] bee [tails] (bee [h], [t]).
- Toŋ sɩ kɩlaŋ tʊmɩyɛ taa, Pɛlɛɛ 0 ɖɔɖɔ tʊmɩyɛ; pɩɩkɛɖɩɣ Pɛlɛɛ 1 ɖɔɖɔ.
Kɛʊ sɩ tʊmɩyɛ taa '[heads]' bee '[tails]' tɛɛ.

message.round_match: Piloto 0 pɩsɩ '{choice0}'; Piloto 1 pɩsɩ '{choice1}'. Match -> Piloto 0 ɛwɛ
message.round_mismatch: Piloto 0 pɩsɩ '{choice0}'; Piloto 1 pɩsɩ '{choice1}'. Mismatch -> Piloto 1 ɛwɛ.

outcome.draw: Pɩtɩŋa payɩ pɩ-taa lɛ, you ŋgʋ kɩtɩwɛɛkɩ.
